en.description:
Play Online with Lichess
Connect with millions of chess players from around the world with Lichess online play. Challenge your friends or find a random opponent with the same skill level.

Play Offline Against Stockfish
Challenge yourself offline with games against the Stockfish engine. No internet? No problem. Hone your skills against a strong opponent even when you’re on the go.

Dive into Chess Puzzles
Sharpen your tactics with a diverse range of chess puzzles. Whether you’re warming up for a game or just challenging yourself, these puzzles are sure to test and enhance your skills.

Watch Lichess TV and Channels
Spectate Lichess TV and channels to catch ongoing games and content. Get insights into various matches and styles of play, all without leaving your wrist.

Tune into Tournament Broadcasts
Stay updated with live broadcasts of chess tournaments. Follow the strategies, tactics, and tension of competitive play, all from the convenience of your watch.

Follow Your Preferred Lichess Players
Keep tabs on your favorite Lichess players. Receive notifications about their latest moves and stay in the loop with their progress and games.

Dive into the chess universe with our Chess App for watchOS. Download now for a comprehensive, on-the-go chess experience.
en.subtitle: Play Chess on your watch
